overview: Based on the published agenda, the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to convene in closed session on October 21, 2026, to hold a pupil expulsion hearing pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes. The Board was expected to hear evidence and arguments related to a student expulsion matter and may have deliberated and taken action in closed session as necessary.

agenda.item: Motion to convene in closed session pursuant to s. 19.85(1)(a), (f), and (g), as well as s. 118.125 of the Wisconsin Statutes to hold a pupil expulsion hearing; Board may deliberate privately and take action if necessary; motion to reconvene into open session; motion to adjourn

discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to convene in closed session to hold a pupil expulsion hearing in accordance with Wisconsin Statutes sections 19.85(1)(a), (f), and (g), and section 118.125. Following the hearing, the Board was expected to deliberate privately and may have taken action on the expulsion matter if deemed necessary and appropriate.

publicComment: No public comment period was included on this agenda.
